display.purpose: View titles, panel headings, stat values — Archivo grotesk, tabular numerals for readouts.

label.purpose: Micro-cap captions: stat labels, panel notes.

mono.purpose: Route codes, counts, endpoints, tokens, code — the code register only.

shadows.name: modal-overlay
shadows.purpose: The system's ONLY shadow — modal separation from the backdrop. Shadow-only, no border (The Seam Rule).

motion.name: flap
motion.value: rotateX flip 420ms with mid-fold opacity dip
motion.purpose: The single authored motion: readouts flip on value change, never glide.

motion.name: deploy
motion.purpose: Stepped deployment of tool lists — flaps fall in order.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion respects the flip and deploy.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The board's single primary action — an amber tab.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 2px; background: #e8a33d; color: #0a0b0d; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 0; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f5b95f; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8a33d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: #a7abb3; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #23272e; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #767c86; color: #ece8e1; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8a33d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: A destination on the board rail: icon, label, mono route code, lit lamp when active.
components.css: .ds-nav { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: #a7abb3; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; border: 0; } .ds-nav code { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #767c86; margin-left: auto; } .ds-nav:hover { color: #ece8e1; background: #14171c; } .ds-nav.active { color: #ece8e1; background: #14171c; } .ds-nav.active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 2px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #e8a33d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(232,163,61,0.2); } .ds-nav.active code { color: #f5b95f; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8a33d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Switch (Board Lever)
components.description: State is the knob: off = muted knob left, on = green knob right. The track never tints.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 40px; height: 22px; } .ds-switch input { opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; position: absolute; } .ds-switch span { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #14171c; border: 1px solid #23272e; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-switch span::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 3px; top: 3px; width: 14px; height: 14px; background: #767c86; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background 160ms; } .ds-switch input:checked + span { border-color: rgba(111,191,115,0.65); } .ds-switch input:checked + span::before { transform: translateX(18px); background: #6fbf73; } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid #e8a33d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stat Readout (Flap Cell)
components.description: A seam-ruled readout: mono code, 34px tabular value that flips on change, micro-cap label, green lamp.
components.css: .ds-stat { background: #101216; padding: 18px 20px 16px; position: relative; } .ds-stat code { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: #767c86; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin: 10px 0 6px; display: inline-block; transform-origin: top center; } .ds-stat-value.flip { animation: ds-flap 420ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) both; } .ds-stat span { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a7abb3; } .ds-stat::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 18px; right: 18px; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #6fbf73; } @keyframes ds-flap { 0% { transform: rotateX(0); opacity: 1; } 45% { transform: rotateX(-88deg); opacity: 0.15; } 55% { transform: rotateX(88deg); opacity: 0.15; } 100% { transform: rotateX(0); opacity: 1; } }

narrative.overview: MCP Workstation is a mechanical split-flap departure board: the whole workstation — every module, tool, server, and token — reads as routes and lamps on one black instrument wall. The design refuses the soft-card AI dashboard completely: nothing floats, nothing glows, no glass, no shadows on in-page surfaces. Panels seat in 1px hairline seams like sheets of metal bolted to a wall; warm paper-white flap type in Archivo with tabular numerals carries every number; every route gets a short mono code (TIM, FET, GIT, CRY, DSH, SRV); and one amber lamp — the board's accent — marks the active route and the primary action. State is a mark, never a hue: a lit lamp, a dim cell, a moving knob, a punched code — never a tinted background. The one authored motion is the flap: values flip in pitched steps (rotateX), they never glide; expanding a module's tool list deploys in stepped order like flaps falling. Elevation is hairline, never shadow; the only shadow in the system is the modal overlay, which is shadow-only by exception.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline seams between every panel — elevation by division, not by shadow
Route codes in IBM Plex Mono for every module, view, and destination
One amber lamp accent; green lamps for on; red reserved for anomalies only
Tabular numerals in every readout — numbers never jiggle
The flip as the single authored motion, with stepped deployment for expansions
Themed browser surfaces: amber caret, amber selection, hairline scrollbars

rules.name: The Lamp Rule
rules.body: A state is a mark, never a tinted background: a lit lamp, a dim cell, a moving knob, a punched code. Green fills, red washes, and tinted cards are all forbidden — the lamp registers on the seam, not the surface.

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber appears on a fraction of any screen: one active route, one primary action, small code chips. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Grotesk Display Rule
rules.body: Display and section titles are Archivo, never mono — mono is the code register, and using it for headings is costume. All numerals use tabular-nums so readouts never jiggle.

rules.name: The Seam Rule
rules.body: Elevation is declared once: either a hairline border or a shadow — never both. A bordered card under a shadow is the ghost card, and it is forbidden.

dos: Do seat panels in 1px hairline seams and rule grids with 1px seam gaps.
Do label every route — modules, views, and stat cells — with a short mono code.
Do render every number in Archivo with tabular numerals.
Do reserve amber for marks: one active route, one primary action, small chips.
Do mark state with lamps, knobs, and punches — lit, dim, moved, punched.
Do flip values on change; deploy tool lists in stepped order.
donts: Don't put a shadow on an in-page panel, or a border on the modal — elevation is declared once.
Don't tint a background to show state; the lamp lives on the seam, not the surface.
Don't use mono for section titles or decoration — mono is the code register only.
Don't use red except for anomalies and destructive actions.
Don't use emoji or glyph icons — icons are drawn SVG in one stroke weight.
Don't glide, tween, or slide readouts — the board flips.
